died.name: Alexander Pushkin
died.cause: to his wife, Natalia Pushkina, after being mortally wounded in a duel with Georges-Charles de Heeckeren d'Anthès, who was rumored to be having an affair with Natalia
died.last_words: Try to be forgotten. Go live in the country. Stay in mourning for two years, then remarry, but choose somebody decent.

died.name: Claude Bernard
died.cause: when a cover was placed to warm his feet
died.last_words: This time it will serve me for the voyage from which there is no return, the voyage of eternity.

died.name: Thomas Kane Wooten
died.cause: prior to death in the Power's Cabin shootout
died.last_words: Throw up your hands! Throw up your hands!

died.name: Pope Pius XI
died.desc: Italian Roman Catholic prelate and Pope

born.name: Charles Lamb
born.last_words: My bedfellows are cramp and cough – we three all in one bed!

born.name: Cliff Burton
born.cause: in a farewell exchange with Anthrax bassist Frank Bello the night before being killed in a tour bus accident in Sweden
